text: Medic 4, two car MVC, minor damage, one patient complaining of neck pain.

text: Found him standing outside his car, airbags didn't deploy.

text: I'm fine, really. My neck's a little sore, that's all.

speaker: M1
text: Were you wearing your seatbelt? Did you hit your head?

speaker: PT
text: Yes, seatbelt. No, I didn't hit anything.

speaker: M1
text: He's A and O times four, no midline tenderness, moves everything.

text: Sir, we recommend you get checked at the hospital. Neck injuries can get worse.

text: Okay. If anything changes, numbness, worse pain, call 911 right away. Sign here for the refusal.

speaker: M1
